name: zylos-browser-remote-extension
_why: Chrome ignores this file entirely -- an MV3 extension is described by manifest.json. It exists ONLY so Node (whose nearest package.json would otherwise be the repo root's "type":"commonjs") will import background.js/actions.js/policy.js/guard.js as ESM in tools/test-extension.js. Do not add dependencies here; the extension ships with zero.
